name: Disneyland Plaza Inn Slow-Cooked Beef Pot Roast with Mashed Potatoes
whyItWorks: Tender, slow-braised chuck roast in savory brown beef gravy over smooth mashed potatoes. The slow braise breaks down beef fibers into easily digested protein.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Pot Roast platter with extra mashed potatoes; enjoy tender beef with gravy.
